title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xdg-desktop-portal security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-55888) in xdg-desktop-portal allows unauthorized host file access via unvalidated FileChooser filenames. This flaw affects the D-Bus portal interfaces exposed by xdg-desktop-portal, which provide APIs for file access and other desktop integration features. Red Hat has issued an important security update for xdg-desktop-portal in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support to address this issue.
